reproduction_attempt.diagnosis: The QEMU emulator mistranslates the SanitizerCoverage indirect-call trampoline in the binary's C++ global constructors, so both images abort before main. LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput and the libjxl modular squeeze decode path are never reached. This is an environment/emulation artifact, identical on vul and fix, NOT the target vulnerability. Reproduction requires a native x86_64 host.

R3_vulnerable_function_reached.evidence: Grounded by OSS-Fuzz crash_state frames (DefaultSqueezeParameters/MetaSqueeze/MetaApply); local reach deferred (emulation).

R4_vulnerable_line_reached.evidence: Source line confirmed in vul image; runtime reach deferred (emulation).

R5_sink_reached.evidence: Source line confirmed (size_t = 8-byte read => matches OSS-Fuzz 'Container-overflow READ 8', crash_state frame0 = DefaultSqueezeParameters). Local asan_reproduce deferred (pre-main emulation abort).

patch_differential.reason: Both images abort pre-main under emulation (no differential possible). Additionally the ARVO fix commit 6dd6fafa is a libvips build-config change (ENABLE_MODULES guard) that removes reachability of the libjxl squeeze path rather than adding the missing channel-count guard, so even on a native host this differential would reflect reachability removal, not a direct guard fix. Deferred to native x86_64.

coverage_tier_B.reason: Line coverage needs a source-coverage rebuild; the target still aborts pre-main under this emulator, and a full libvips+libjxl rebuild is out of budget on an emulated host. Run llvm-cov/gcov on native amd64.

taint_tier_C.reason: DFSan needs a harness change + rebuild and a host that can run the target past main. Run on native amd64.

summary: GT is fully source-consistent: all source/root_cause/sink lines match the vulnerable image byte-for-byte and the sink type/size match the authoritative OSS-Fuzz 'Container-overflow READ 8' crash_state. No GT field is refuted. Runtime witnessing (R1-R5, S1, patch_differential, coverage, taint) is DEFERRED because this amd64-on-arm64 emulation host aborts both images pre-main in the SanitizerCoverage trampoline; the libjxl squeeze path is never reached. Requires a native x86_64 host to convert deferred -> verified.
